newsitem.title: UK: Rank opens weaker, hit by trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Rank opens weaker, hit by trading statement.

text.p: Rank Group Plc shares started the session weaker after a trading statement which analysts said was disappointing on profits growth.
The stock was 21-1/2p lower at 404p by 0734 GMT having pared 2p of its opening loss.
Rank said operating profits from continuing businesses rose by 7.0 percent in the first five months of the year.

"We were expecting higher operating profits, around 17 percent, which implies that hopes of steady to slightly higher pre-tax figures for the first half of around 100 million stg may be disappointed," said UBS analyst, Paul Heath.
Analysts said pre-tax profits forecasts for the year would be reduced to around 320 million stg from around 340 million.
Bearish news on video duplication was the other main reason for the share price fall, they said.

"As reported at the annual general meeting in April, the first quarter was a quiet period for video releases and this has continued such that U.S. video duplication volume for the five months was 25 percent below that for the corresponding period for last year," the group said.
"As a result, average capacity utilisation was well below that comparative level in 1996."
The video duplication news hit Carlton Communications Plc also with the stock price falling 16p to 499-1/2p.
